locator.text: Equation (7.29), p. 83, in the statement of Lemma 7.4

evidence: paper: |\det \mathsf{H}| \ge c/S_*, \qquad \|\mathsf{H}^{-1}\| \le C\sqrt{S_*}, \qquad c\sqrt{S_*}\,|T| \le y_\sigma \le C\sqrt{S_*}\,|T|.

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The three clauses are packaged as one Lean structure, with R = sqrt(S_n) playing the paper's sqrt(S_*). Clause 1 is literal: `determinant` says detGap ≤ |det(normalizedMatrix R H)|, and `normalizedMatrix_det` rewrites that as detGap ≤ R^2 |det H| = S_n |det H|, i.e. |det H| ≥ detGap/S_*. The lower half of clause 3 is literal in the Lean's variables: `weights` says inverseLower*R*zeta ≤ y_j, i.e. y_sigma ≥ c sqrt(S_*) zeta, where the Lean carries the flat edge factor zeta instead of |T| (the target is FlatCovariance.scaledTarget zeta (T0 p) = zeta·T0, with T0 continuous and, by the strict cone hypothesis, nonvanishing on the compact K, so |T| ≍ zeta there). Clause 2 and the upper half of clause 3 are not stated as such, but follow in two lines from the stated `entries` and `determinant` fields by the 2x2 Cramer/adjugate identities that the file already uses: |H i j| ≤ entryBound/R and |det H| ≥ detGap/R^2 give |(H⁻¹) i j| = |adj(H) i j|/|det H| ≤ (entryBound/R)·(R^2/detGap) = C·sqrt(S_*), and y_j = cramerNumerator_j/det H gives |y_j| ≤ 2(entryBound/R)|T|·(R^2/detGap) = C sqrt(S_*) |T|.
